findings.title: UPS create-json silently removes supplied identity and sends no Workitem UID
findings.status: Open; requires narrow repair or explicit unqualified route, not an oracle-only normalization
findings.observed: Both clients remove input00080018 with uid=nil, then POST /dicom-web/workitems without a workitem query parameter. The capture peer assigns an unrelated identity. DT and SCHEDULED state remain correct, but equivalent client behavior alone does not prove a standards-valid Create request.
findings.standard: DICOM PS3.18 2026a 11.4.1.1 requires a Workitem UID in a Worklist-target payload; the alternative Workitem target conveys the UID using the workitem query parameter. The UID is absent from both places in the observed request.
findings.verified_source_version: DICOM PS3.18 2026a - Web Services; official complete HTML accessed26October2026. Section-only endpoint returned cache miss, so complete HTML section was inspected.
findings.recommended_narrow_resolution: Resolve a validated intended UID and convey it through the documented workitem query target before removing it from the body. Preserve supplied input identity; avoid silently accepting contradictory identities. Verify repaired CLI/native requests and refresh source/binary attribution.
findings.impact_on_existing_items: NET06 date/time behavior remains substantiated. Keep QUAL01/M7 open for existing UPS route qualification. Do not add an enhancement or silently alter the68-item scope.
